_help: Team members shown on the Company and Investors pages. The Team section stays hidden while `members` is empty. Copy `_example` into `members` for each person. `photo` is optional: put a square JPG/WebP in src/assets/img/team/ and give its file name.

background.en: One or two sentences on relevant experience.
background.it: Una o due frasi sull'esperienza rilevante.

whyUs.en: Optional: why this person is right for this problem, now.
whyUs.it: Facoltativo: perché questa persona è giusta per questo problema, adesso.
